state.misconception_label: Divides total amount by each side of the ratio instead of dividing by the sum of the parts

turn_history.text: Imagine you have a pizza that is divided into 3 slices and 5 slices. If you were to add up the number of slices in each part, would that give you the total number of slices in the whole pizza? Think about how this relates to the ratio of AN : NB being 3:5.
